title: Artyx agent preset frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of agents/<name>/agent.md. An agent preset is an Artyx subagent, not an Agent Plugin: the 1.0.0 specification defines exactly two component types, skills and MCP servers, and deliberately leaves agents out. Presets therefore live beside plugins/ rather than inside a plugin, and this schema is entirely our own.

name.description: Display name in the agent picker. Free-form prose, unlike a skill name: this is a label, not an identifier. The directory name is the identifier.

description.description: What the agent does and when to reach for it.

tools.description: Tool ids the preset may call. Only their shape is checked here: the catalog lives in the desktop build, so a name that does not exist there is rejected at install time. Use minArtyxVersion to steer users to a build that has them.

avatarColor.description: Accent token for the avatar. Absent means accent. These are the desktop's five semantic tokens, not free colors.

model.description: Text model as provider/model, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.

minArtyxVersion.description: Minimum desktop version, required when the preset calls a tool older builds do not ship.
